description: This file defines the HelpConfigService class within the OrangeHRM Help module. The class extends a base ConfigService and provides methods to retrieve help-related configuration values such as the processor class and base URL.

classes.name: HelpConfigService
classes.description: A service class that provides access to help configuration settings, such as help processor class and URL, extending the core ConfigService.

methods.name: getHelpProcessorClass
methods.description: Returns the configured help processor class string.

methods.name: getBaseHelpUrl
methods.description: Returns the base help URL string from the configuration.
